Subject: Executive sponsor intro & MAP kickoff — Nimbus Health evaluation plan

Priya / Amit —

Thanks again for the time on Friday. Per our conversation I wanted to introduce the Redwood executives who will be engaged during the evaluation and lay out a short mutual action plan (MAP) to keep timelines clear. Our goal is to make the evaluation low-friction and to ensure your exec stakeholders have an escalation path and measurable outcomes for the quarter.

Quick intros (internal):
- Jonas Weber — Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference (me) — primary exec contact for timelines and commercial alignment.
- Rishi Malhotra — Account Executive — day-to-day deal owner and demo owner.
- Marissa Cole — Customer Success — will own POC success criteria and onboarding plan.
- Markus Klein — VP, Platform Partnerships — available for executive escalations and contract-level discussions.

Suggested MAP high-level (attached: Nimbus-MAP-Draft-v1.pdf):
1) Week 1 (this week): Confirm exec sponsor & CTO alignment; agree on must-have evaluation criteria (latency, throughput, security artifacts).
2) Week 2: Technical deep-dive + sandpit access; security questionnaire items 1–10 answered; sample dataset walkthrough.
3) Week 3: Run 2 small-scale production-like tests; capture latency/cost per 1k tokens; iterate on config.
4) Week 4: Exec review with outcomes and recommendation; finalize next steps (pilot vs purchase).

As part of this I want to explicitly capture exec sponsors so we can coordinate check-ins:
- Nimbus exec sponsor (please confirm): Priya Rao, VP Product (executive sponsor)
- Nimbus technical sponsor (please confirm): Amit Desai, CTO (technical escalation)

A couple of asks to get started:
- Priya/Amit: confirm the two sponsor names above and add any other stakeholders you want in the MAP roster.
- Lindsey (cc): if you own procurement/login or contract cadence, please confirm milestone dates for approvals.

I've attached a one-page MAP draft and a proposed stakeholder roster (spreadsheet). If that looks good I'll schedule a 30-minute kickoff with the group later this week.

Best,
Jonas
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0142

2) Security/compliance artifacts are required for our InfoSec review. Please include a contact for SOC 2 / data retention questions (we'll share the security questionnaire today).

If possible, can we schedule the kickoff on Wed 9 Jun 11:00–11:30 AM ET?

- A condensed 3-week MAP is doable if we compress the technical sandbox to a two-day access window and prioritize the must-have evals (latency at 95th percentile, token cost, and basic privacy constraints).
- Marissa will own the success criteria doc; she'll post a short form that we can all agree to before the sandbox access.
- For SOC 2 / data retention: Markus will be the exec escalation but our security lead, Soojin Lee, will be the subject matter contact. I've attached a pointer to the security pack in Drive.

Proposed kickoff: Wed 9 Jun 11:00 AM ET — I'll send a calendar invite with goals and pre-reads.

Jonas / Rishi — thanks for the clear plan. A couple of technical / process requests before kickoff:
1) Can you confirm the proposed sandpit environment will be isolated (VPC-level) and that logs/data from the sandbox are retained for 7 days by default? We need to validate data handling for PHI-adjacent records.
2) Please share a brief escalation matrix: who do we call when a test impacts production traffic or when we find a blocker that needs exec attention?
3) On the timeline: we can aim for a 3-week MAP but will need immediate answers on the security questionnaire items related to encryption in transit and at rest.

I'll be on the kickoff Wed 9 Jun at 11:00 AM ET if that works for everyone — Priya, Lindsey too?

Perfect — thanks all for the quick responses. Short summary / next steps before the Wed kickoff (11:00–11:30 AM ET):
- Jonas/Rishi: we'll publish the one-page MAP + roles to the Drive link and update the MAP to the compressed 3-week timeline.
- Marissa: will circulate the success criteria short-form by EOD Tue and own measurable checkpoints for each week.
- Markus / Soojin (security SME): I'll share the security pack link and have Soojin on the kickoff to answer the SOC 2 questions and data-retention specifics.
- Amit: sandbox environment will be VPC-isolated; default logs retained 7 days. I'll confirm the endpoint and credentials in the kickoff invite.

4) Agree launch criteria and tentative pilot dates (5 min)

Calendar invite sent. Looking forward to the call.
